name: SOSA Platform
abstract: OMS alignment: implements the ISO 19156:2023 (OGC Topic 20 / O&M 3.0) `obs-cpt/Host` requirement class for `sosa:Platform`. This building block defines the set of properties for an observation Platform according to the SOSA/SSN specification. These properties may be directly included into a root element of a JSON object or used in the properties container of a GeoJSON feature.
